relations.subject: Carmen Blacker
relations.evidence: She was a lecturer in Japanese at the University of Cambridge.

relations.subject: Carmen Blacker
relations.object: School of Oriental and African Studies (SOAS)
relations.evidence: In 1942 she began attending the School of Oriental and African Studies (SOAS) in London

relations.subject: Carmen Blacker
relations.evidence: She met the Orientalist and sinologist Arthur Waley at Bletchley Park, and he inspired her to study Chinese in her spare time.

relations.subject: Carmen Blacker
relations.evidence: In 1944 she arranged to receive lessons in Japanese from Major General Francis S. G. Piggott.

relations.subject: Carmen Blacker
relations.evidence: After graduating from SOAS in 1947 she began her studies at Somerville College, Oxford.

relations.subject: Carmen Blacker
relations.evidence: In 1955 she was appointed an assistant lecturer at the University of Cambridge

relations.subject: Carmen Blacker
relations.evidence: in 1958 she became University Lecturer in Japanese Studies.

relations.subject: Carmen Blacker
relations.evidence: She married her longtime partner, the Chinese scholar Michael Loewe, in 2002.
